steadyscrape/tiktok-creative-center-scra.title: TikTok Creative Center Top Ads Scraper

input_schema.title: TikTok Creative Center Top Ads Scraper input

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: The markets whose top ads you want; each country is its own search of up to 400 ads. Leave the list empty for one search across all markets together.
countries.sectionDescription: Every combination of country, keyword and industry is one search, ranked by TikTok. An ad found by two searches is delivered (and charged) once.

period.title: Period
period.description: Ads that ran in the last 7, 30 or 180 days. 180 days gives the most ads (TikTok shows at most 400 per search).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search the ads by product, brand or theme (skincare, running shoes, temu). Each keyword is its own search. Leave empty for the overall ranking.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: TikTok's industry names, as in Creative Center: Apparel & Accessories, Beauty & Personal Care, Games, Women's Clothing, Skincare… (any case; "and" works for "&"), or their numeric ids. Each industry is its own search. An unknown name comes back as a free row with similar names.

objectives.title: Campaign objectives
objectives.description: Keep only ads bought for these objectives. Empty for all.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: The order TikTok ranks the ads in. With a maximum below 400, it decides which ads you get.

adLanguage.title: Ad language
adLanguage.description: Keep only ads in this language.

adFormat.title: Ad format
adFormat.description: Spark ads are creators' own posts boosted as ads; non-Spark ads are uploaded by the advertiser.

maxAdsPerSearch.title: Max ads per search
maxAdsPerSearch.description: In TikTok's order. TikTok ranks at most 400 ads for one search; to get more, add countries, keywords or industries.

includeDetails.title: Add each ad's page (landing page, comments, shares, markets, AI analysis)
includeDetails.description: Opens each ad's page in Creative Center: the landing page URL, comments and shares, every country the ad ran in, the campaign objectives, Creative Center's note on why the ad works and, for the ads it has one, its AI analysis of the hook and structure. Charged as ad-with-details instead of ad.

onlyNewAds.title: Only ads new since the last run (monitor)
onlyNewAds.description: Turns a scheduled run into a monitor: ads an earlier monitor run of yours already delivered are skipped for free, so each run delivers only the ads that entered the ranking since.

ad.eventDescription: One top ad from Creative Center's ranking: ad copy, brand, industry, objective, likes, CTR rank, budget tier, badge, video links and cover. Rows that say why a search gave nothing (no_ads, invalid, blocked), duplicates and ads a monitor already delivered are free.

ad-with-details.eventDescription: One top ad together with its own page in Creative Center: landing page, comments, shares, every market it ran in, objectives, Creative Center's highlight and AI analysis. Charged instead of Ad, only in runs with details on; an ad whose page does not answer is charged as a plain Ad.

tortuga/tiktok-shop-scraper.title: TikTok Shop Scraper — Products, Prices & Sales

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords to search on TikTok Shop US, one per line (e.g. "bluetooth speaker", "lip gloss"). Each term is paginated automatically: 25-30 products per request; TikTok's web shop stops after about 150 products per keyword.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: TikTok Shop US URLs instead of (or in addition to) search terms: product pages (https://shop.tiktok.com/us/pdp/<slug>/<id>, www.tiktok.com/shop/pdp/... or a bare product id; always returned with full details), shop pages (https://shop.tiktok.com/us/store/<name>/<seller_id>, all products of the shop), category pages (https://shop.tiktok.com/us/c/<name>/<id>) and keyword pages (/us/k/<keyword>, /us/s?q=<keyword>; run as a search).

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many products in total (across all search terms and URLs). Keeps cost predictable.

includeDetails.title: Include product details
includeDetails.description: Also open every product page to get all variants / SKUs with their own price and stock, shipping fee and delivery estimate, the shop profile (rating, followers, products sold, response scores), description, specifications, all images, category path, rating breakdown and the top reviews TikTok shows on the page (up to 3). One extra request and one extra `detail` charge per product (see pricing).

sortBy.title: Sort search results
sortBy.description: Order of search-term results, as in TikTok Shop's own "Sort by" menu. TikTok sometimes answers sorted searches with a short unsorted list; the actor asks again and, if needed, falls back to relevance order (listed in the run's SUMMARY as sortFallback). Does not apply to shop and category URLs.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Max pages per search, shop or category
maxPagesPerSource.description: How many result pages to load per search term (25-30 products each), shop (20 each) or category URL (category pages show 10-15 products each; further pages are the category's subcategories).

includeSubcategories.title: Follow subcategories
includeSubcategories.description: For category URLs: TikTok's public category page lists only 10-15 products, so the actor continues with the category's subcategories (each another 10-15 products) until Max pages or Max items is reached.

onlyNewOrChanged.title: Only new or changed items
onlyNewOrChanged.description: Remember what earlier runs of this search returned and output only new items or items whose price/status changed. Use with a Schedule; unchanged items are not charged. With this on, Max items is the number of products checked each run (the watched window, e.g. the first 50 search results), so a run never digs deeper than the first one. Price, crossed-out price and the lowest / highest variant price are compared; product pages are only opened for new or changed products.

monitoringKey.title: Monitoring key
monitoringKey.description: Name for this watch, so several schedules on the same search stay separate; defaults to a key derived from the search input.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify's default datacenter proxy works and is the cheapest choice (no per-request proxy fee). Pages that come back as TikTok's 'Security Check' captcha (about 1 in 20 product pages) are retried automatically on a new IP. Residential proxies are not needed and were not more reliable in tests.

result.eventDescription: One product saved to the dataset from a keyword search, shop page, category page or product URL (title, price, original price, discount, units sold, rating, review count, shop, image, labels, rank).

detail.eventDescription: Charged in addition to the result event for each product whose page is opened: with 'Include product details' on, or for product URLs (all variants / SKUs with price and stock, shipping fee and delivery estimate, shop profile, description, specifications, images, category path, rating breakdown, top reviews).

result.eventDescription: One product saved to the dataset from a keyword search, shop page, category page or product URL (title, price, original price, discount, units sold, rating, review count, shop, image, labels, rank).

detail.eventDescription: Charged in addition to the result event for each product whose page is opened: with 'Include product details' on, or for product URLs (all variants / SKUs with price and stock, shipping fee and delivery estimate, shop profile, description, specifications, images, category path, rating breakdown, top reviews).

country.title: Deliver to
country.description: Where prices, delivery dates and shipping costs are quoted for. Prices are in USD.

products.title: Products
products.description: Amazon.com ASINs or product URLs (amzn.to and a.co short links work). One dataset item per product, with details, specifications, variants and every offer.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on Amazon.com. One dataset item per search result.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Search result pages to read per query (roughly 20-60 results each).

freeShippingOnly.title: Free shipping only
freeShippingOnly.description: Skip products and search results without free shipping.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many dataset items (caps your cost). Empty = no limit.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

product.eventDescription: One Amazon product with full details (brand, rating, bullets, images, specifications, best-sellers rank, variants) and every seller offer.

search-result.eventDescription: One product from Amazon keyword search, with price, rating and shipping.

input_schema.title: Google Trends Scraper input
input_schema.description: Enter one or more search terms to scrape their Google Trends data. You can also paste Google Trends URLs or load terms from a public Google Sheet.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: (Required if 'spreadsheetId' is not provided) List of search terms to be scraped.

isMultiple.title: Multiple terms
isMultiple.description: If checked, a comma is treated as a separator for multiple terms

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Choose a predefined search's time range (defaults to 'Past 12 months')

geo.title: Geo area
geo.description: Get results from a specific geo area (defaults to 'Worldwide'). This maps to different fields in the dataset results: smaller countries like Greece return just 'interestByCity' data, while larger ones like the United States return 'interestBySubregion' data as well. When omitted (Worldwide), 'interestBy' is returned instead, which corresponds to the 'Interest by area' section on Google Trends. Note: When using Google Trends URLs from the '🔗 Use a Google Trends URL instead of search terms' section, the geo parameter from the URL's query string takes precedence over this setting. You can also use start URLs to retrieve 'interestByMetro' data for metropolitan areas by providing URLs with more specific geo regions like California (US) directly copied from Google Trends.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max request retries

collection.title: Collection

onlyAvailable.title: Only products in stock

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel requests
maxConcurrency.description: How many items to process at the same time.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

offgrid-labs/reddit-scraper.title: Reddit Scraper - Posts, Comments & Replies, Search, Users

clientId.title: Reddit client ID (optional)
clientId.sectionDescription: Reddit credentials are optional. Provide a client ID and secret to use Reddit's official OAuth Data API (application-only, read-only). Leave both empty to use Reddit's public JSON endpoints instead — no credentials required.
clientId.description: Optional. Client ID of your own Reddit app (the string under the app name at https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps). Used only for application-only OAuth (client_credentials grant, read-only). Leave empty with the secret to use the public JSON path. Example: p-jcoLKBynTLew

clientSecret.title: Reddit client secret (optional)
clientSecret.description: Optional. Secret of the same Reddit app (field labelled "secret" at https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps). Stored encrypted by Apify; never logged. If the ID/secret is rejected, the actor falls back to the public JSON path.

appName.title: Your Reddit app name (User-Agent)
appName.description: Name of your Reddit app, sent as a descriptive User-Agent when OAuth credentials are provided, e.g. apify:offgrid-labs-reddit-scraper:0.1 (app: my-research-app). Example: my-research-app

redditUsername.title: Your Reddit username (optional, User-Agent)
redditUsername.description: Optional. The Reddit username that owns the app; appended to the User-Agent as (by /u/<name>) as Reddit recommends. Not used to log in. Example: my_reddit_name

subreddits.title: Subreddits
subreddits.description: Subreddit names or URLs, one per line; posts are read from each subreddit's listing chosen in Sort. Formats: webscraping, r/webscraping, https://www.reddit.com/r/webscraping. all = r/all.

sort.title: Subreddit / user sort
sort.description: Listing used for subreddits and user profiles. top and controversial use the Time filter. Default hot.

timeFilter.title: Time filter
timeFilter.description: Time window for top/controversial listings and for search (relevance/top/comments sorts). Default day.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Optional. Reddit search queries, one per line; each returns matching posts. Reddit search syntax works, e.g. "exact phrase", title:pricing, author:name, OR. Example: "web scraping" api

searchInSubreddits.title: Restrict search to subreddits
searchInSubreddits.description: Optional. Limit Search queries to these subreddits (searched together). Empty = all of Reddit. Example: python, learnpython

searchSort.title: Search sort
searchSort.description: Order of search results. Default new.

postUrls.title: Post URLs (full comment trees)
postUrls.description: Optional. Reddit post URLs, redd.it links or post IDs; each returns the post plus its comment tree (limited by Max comments per post and Comment depth). Example: https://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/abc123/title/

users.title: Usernames (public posts / comments)
users.description: Optional. Reddit usernames or profile URLs, one per line; returns their public posts and/or comments (see User content). Example: spez or https://www.reddit.com/user/spez

userContent.title: User content
userContent.description: Which public profile listings to read for Usernames. Default both.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max posts per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Maximum records read from each subreddit, search query or user listing (Reddit's listings stop at about 1,000). One saved record = one charged event. Default 100. Example: 25

includeComments.title: Also fetch comments of listed posts
includeComments.description: If true, the comment tree of every post from subreddits and searches is fetched too (one extra API request per post; comments are charged as comment events). Post URLs always include comments. Default false.

maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post
maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum comments saved per post (Post URLs, and listed posts when Also fetch comments is on). Collapsed "load more" branches are expanded until this limit. 0 = posts only. Default 100.

commentDepth.title: Comment depth
commentDepth.description: Maximum reply depth: 0 = top-level comments only, 1 = plus direct replies, and so on. Default 10.

commentSort.title: Comment sort
commentSort.description: Order in which comments are read (matters when Max comments per post cuts the tree). Default confidence (Reddit's "Best").

expandMoreComments.title: Expand "load more comments"
expandMoreComments.description: If true (default), collapsed comment branches are expanded via the API's morechildren endpoint until Max comments per post is reached.

includeDeleted.title: Include deleted / removed items
includeDeleted.description: If true, deleted and removed posts/comments are saved (body and author null, isDeleted / isRemoved = true) and charged. Default false: they are skipped and not charged.

skipNsfw.title: Skip NSFW (over 18) posts
skipNsfw.description: If true, posts and comments marked over_18 are skipped and not charged. Default false.

demo.title: Demo mode (fixed sample, not charged)
demo.description: If true, the actor returns a small fixed sample (demo: true) without contacting Reddit, and never charges. Turn it off for live data (public JSON path or your own OAuth credentials).

publicRequestBudget.title: Public path request budget
publicRequestBudget.description: Maximum HTTP requests the public (no-credential) JSON path may make per run. Reaching it ends the run cleanly with whatever was collected. Ignored when OAuth credentials are used. Default 300.

proxyList.title: Proxy list (optional, secret)
proxyList.sectionDescription: Optional. Route requests through your own proxies. Precedence: your proxy list > Apify-managed proxy > direct connection. Proxy credentials are used only in memory to make requests and are never logged or stored in results.
proxyList.description: One proxy per line (or comma-separated), as http(s)://user:pass@host:port or host:port (credentials optional). The actor rotates across them and fails over to the next healthy one on 403/429/5xx/timeout. Leave empty to connect directly (or pair with Use Apify proxy).

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify proxy
useApifyProxy.description: If true (and no proxy list is supplied), route requests through Apify's managed proxy using the group chosen below. Requires Apify proxy to be enabled for this actor. Default false.

proxyGroups.title: Apify proxy group
proxyGroups.description: Apify proxy pool: DATACENTERS (fastest), RESIDENTIAL (rotating IPs), or UNBLOCKER (most reliable against blocking).

proxyRotation.title: Proxy rotation strategy
proxyRotation.description: How proxies are chosen. round_robin cycles in order (default); random picks uniformly; sticky_window holds one proxy for the configured window then moves on. Default round_robin.

stickyWindow.title: Sticky window size
stickyWindow.description: Requests per proxy before rotating, when rotation strategy is sticky_window. Default 15.

proxyMaxRetries.title: Proxy failover retries
proxyMaxRetries.description: How many additional proxies to try after a request fails (403/429/5xx/timeout) before giving up on that request. Default 2.

proxyMaxFailures.title: Max failures before blacklisting a proxy
proxyMaxFailures.description: Consecutive failures after which a proxy is blacklisted (skipped) for the rest of the run. A proxy-auth rejection (407/401) blacklists immediately. Default 5.

userAgent.title: Custom User-Agent (advanced, optional)
userAgent.description: Optional. Overrides the default User-Agent sent on the public JSON path (ignored on the official Data API path).

post.eventDescription: One Reddit post saved to the dataset (demo records are not charged).

comment.eventDescription: One Reddit comment saved to the dataset (demo records are not charged).

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
